roles.name: fast_scan

roles.name: explorer
roles.description: Luna: locate files, callers, configuration and evidence; return searched scope.

roles.name: deep_explorer
roles.description: GPT-6.2 Sol: investigate ambiguous behavior and interactions across components.

roles.name: worker

roles.name: standard_worker
roles.description: GPT-6.1 Terra: scoped code fixes following established patterns with understood interfaces and targeted checks.

roles.name: visual_worker
roles.description: GPT-6.1 Terra: visual understanding, UI checks and defined browser or desktop tasks grounded in observed evidence.

roles.name: writing_worker
roles.description: GPT-6.1 Terra: concise documentation and revisions grounded in supplied material, audience and voice.

roles.name: complex_worker

roles.name: expert_worker

roles.name: test_diagnostician

roles.name: reviewer
roles.description: Luna: scoped routine review against explicit requirements and checks.

roles.name: deep_reviewer
roles.description: GPT-6.2 Sol: consequential correctness, subtle regressions and integration review.

roles.name: evaluator
roles.description: GPT-6.2 Sol: deep criteria-based evaluation through UI, API, mobile, debugger and file checks; critique and targeted retesting without source edits.

roles.name: quick_evaluator

roles.name: visual_evaluator
roles.description: GPT-6.1 Terra: inspect actual images, screenshots, renders and visual media against criteria; capture evidence without editing deliverables.

roles.name: security_reviewer

roles.name: planner
roles.description: GPT-6.2 Sol: resolve uncertain decomposition; return assignments, dependencies and acceptance checks.

roles.name: brainstorm
roles.description: GPT-6.2 Astra: develop concepts, generate possibilities and turn explicit ideation requests into useful directions.

roles.name: expert
roles.description: GPT-6.2 Astra: hardest planning, diagnosis or review; resolve consequential uncertainty and specialist disagreement.

roles.name: advisor
roles.description: GPT-6.2 Astra: on-demand advice for focused agent questions; recommend approaches and tradeoffs without implementing or issuing acceptance verdicts.

roles.name: docs_researcher
roles.description: Luna: focused source lookup, API/version verification and evidence packets.

roles.name: web_searcher
roles.description: Luna: one bounded research angle without reasoning overhead; use docs_researcher if unavailable.

roles.name: web_coordinator
roles.description: Luna: isolate substantial research coordination; delegate independent questions and process results as they arrive.

roles.name: web_verifier
roles.description: GPT-6.2 Sol: verify disputed, consequential or weakly supported claims with targeted follow-up sources.
